content: Management Harness architecture (from implementation_plan.md): a Go-based proxy gateway sitting between AI dev tools (Claude Desktop/Code, Cursor, Cline, custom agents) and upstream LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini). Provides unified API-key auth, per-user/team/org budget enforcement, prompt-injection and PII protection via a security guardian, policy-driven model routing, immutable audit logging, and an admin dashboard. Built from modular LEGO-style components (auth, budget, guardian, policy, router, cache, optimizer) each independently developed, tested, and deployed. Runs as a standalone Docker Compose stack (PostgreSQL, Redis, Prometheus, Grafana), deployable alone or alongside the Laiw Legal OS platform. Strategy is MVP-first: an 8-week MVP delivering proxy plus auth, budget, guardian, and audit logging, then layering policy engine, model router, prompt optimizer, and full dashboard.
